prompt:
Generate a production sprite animation sheet for the 16-bit arcade game Bullets of Fury. Reference image is PALETTE AND PIXEL DETAIL ONLY: its vertical flames and vertical lightning-like white stripe are WRONG and must NOT be copied.
Create EIGHT sequential animation frames of a broad inferno blazing HORIZONTALLY LEFT. Layout exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, edge-to-edge equal rectangular cells, no gutters, no labels, no text, no grid lines. Canvas square 2048x2048 if possible, each cell 512 wide by 1024 tall. Frame order left-to-right then next row. Each frame shows the SAME fixed wall of fire at the SAME scale and anchor: bright orange-white fire roots on the RIGHT side, wide horizontal branching tongues of gold/orange fire thrust and curl LEFT over a dense dark crimson fiery background. No up-pointing flames. No narrow vertical laser line. Fire must visibly be blown from RIGHT TO LEFT across the full width, covering the entire frame. Several horizontal tongues stacked through the height. Their roots remain in fixed positions while their tips flare, stretch, curl and break into embers leftward from frame to frame in a smooth looping sequence. Eighth pose leads back into first. This is hand-drawn frame animation, NOT successive translated or vertically scrolled versions of one image. Frame corners and top/bottom remain filled opaque deep ember red so no underlying island can be seen. Detailed crisp chunky pixel clusters, restrained SNES/Neo Geo arcade palette, gold inner flame highlights, dark red shadows; not smooth photoreal fire. Fixed camera, no pan, no rotation, no zoom. Different flame shapes each frame but strong animation continuity, consistent density and brightness. Do not include islands, terrain, UI, characters, words or water. No checkerboard. Entire sheet opaque.
